versos.texto_bv: E lhe dirão: “Que feridas são essas em suas mãos?” E ele dirá: “Fui ferido na casa dos meus amantes.”
versos.traducao_literal: E dirão a ele: “Que as feridas, essas, entre as tuas mãos?” E dirá: “Que fui ferido, casa dos que me amam.”
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): A BV traduz o termo hebraico por “meus amantes”, mas as três referências convergem em “meus amigos” (NTLH, ARA e NVIPT são unânimes), e a própria traducao_literal da BV usa a glosa neutra “os que me amam”, sem a conotação erótica/extraconjugal que “amante” carrega no português contemporâneo. — evidência: texto_bv: “na casa dos meus amantes”; traducao_literal: “casa dos que me amam”; NTLH/ARA/NVIPT: “na casa dos meus amigos” (as três).

kjv.texto: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.

vizinhos.5: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.
vizinhos.7: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the Lord of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.

web.texto: One will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’

vizinhos.5: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.’
vizinhos.7: “Awake, sword, against my shepherd, and against the man who is close to me,” says Yahweh of Armies. “Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.
